tasks.goal: Independently propose a practical production security boundary for Plaesy model cache across Linux/macOS/Windows, given laya-decision 0.2.20 only loads by path and agent internals are private. Assess whether restricting ownership/permissions plus cooperative lock genuinely closes different-UID attacks, what remains uncloseable for same-UID processes, and platform APIs/crates for safe handle-relative traversal. Read-only; provide recommended next concrete implementation and test plan.
